source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For real ThreadCard rows, the landing reads one properties set to select new/read/unread text and writes the same properties string to the dataset used by CSS. New and unread give the status image distinct Fluent IDs; read rows hide the image through a default display:none while preserving a status column. New icon CSS is nested under unread, so this is a scoped contract with the supplied property combination, not proof of all native flag states. The added test checks visibility and Fluent IDs, not a live tooltip or accessible-tree result.
title: Card status localization and CSS use the same new/read/unread state
